## Founding Design Partner Application

Thank you for your interest in becoming a zk0 founding design partner! Founding design partners are the first external labs and operators to run zk0 nodes on their own robot arms and their own data, and to shape the node design while it is still being formed. Please fill out this application form completely. We'll review your application and contact you via Discord for next steps.

### Contact Information

- **Name/Organization**: [Your full name or organization/lab name]
- **Contact Person**: [Name of the person we will work with day to day]
- **Discord Username**: [Your Discord handle, e.g., @username#1234]
- **Email**: [Your email address for backup contact]
- **Location/Timezone**: [Your location and timezone, e.g., "San Francisco, PST"]

### Robot Arm & Setup

- **Arm Model**: [e.g., SO-100, SO-101, or other LeRobot-compatible arm]
- **Cameras**: [Camera setup used for recording, e.g., top/front/wrist]
- **Teleoperation Setup**: [Leader arm, or other demonstration method]
- **Workspace**: [Brief description of the bench/lab setup the arm runs in]

### Data & Tasks

- **Dataset Type**: [SO-100, SO-101, or Custom LeRobot-compatible]
- **Hosting Location**: [Hugging Face (hf:username/repo) or Local path]
- **Number of Episodes**: [Episodes recorded so far, and episodes you plan to record]
- **Task Description**: [Brief description of the robotics task(s), e.g., "Pick and place colored objects", "Stack blocks of different sizes"]
- **Data Collection Method**: [How is the data collected? Real robot, simulation, etc.]
- **Episode Length**: [Average frames per episode]

### Compute Available

- **Operating System**: [e.g., Ubuntu 22.04, macOS 13, Windows 11 WSL2]
- **CPU**: [e.g., Intel i7-10700K, AMD Ryzen 9 5900X]
- **RAM**: [Amount in GB, e.g., 32GB]
- **GPU**: [Model and VRAM, e.g., NVIDIA RTX 3080 12GB, or "None"]
- **Storage**: [Available disk space in GB, e.g., 500GB SSD]
- **Network**: [Connection type and speed, e.g., "100Mbps broadband"]
- **Availability**: [How often can you run the node? Daily, weekly, etc.]

### Timeline & Commitment

- **Node Start**: [When could your node realistically go live?]
- **Time Commitment**: [Hours per week you can dedicate during the founding cohort]
- **What You Want to Validate**: [What do you want to prove or learn by running a node on your own data?]
- **Design Feedback**: [Are you willing to give structured feedback on the node experience — installation, data handling, round scheduling, validation? What form suits you: calls, written notes, issue reports?]

### Privacy & Compliance

- **Data Ownership**: [Do you own this data or have permission to use it?]
- **Privacy Requirements**: [Any specific privacy constraints or requirements?]
- **Commercial Use**: [Will this data be used commercially? Any licensing restrictions?]

### Additional Information

- **Motivation**: [Why do you want to join the founding design partner cohort?]
- **Special Requirements**: [Any special setup requirements or constraints?]
- **Questions/Comments**: [Any questions or additional information?]

### Checklist

- [ ] I have read the zk0 Node Operators Guide and the Founding Design Partners page
- [ ] I have a physical robot arm (SO-100, SO-101, or LeRobot-compatible) and my own dataset, or a concrete plan to record one
- [ ] I have verified my hardware meets the minimum requirements
- [ ] I understand that only model updates leave my machine (no raw data)
- [ ] I have a stable internet connection for federated learning
- [ ] I commit to running a zk0 node on my own data as part of the founding cohort, and to sharing design feedback with the zk0 team
- [ ] I take full responsibility for owning the contributed data and confirm I have the legal right to license the resulting model weights (from local training) to the zk0.bot community. I understand and agree that these model weights may be aggregated into a global shared model, licensed under the Apache License 2.0 (https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0), allowing the community unrestricted use for model training, inference, and any application (academic, DIY, or commercial). I have read and agree to the license terms.

---

**Next Steps**: After submitting this application, join our [zk0.bot Discord server](https://discord.gg/dhMnEne7RP) to ask questions, connect with the community, and check on your application status in real-time. Our team typically reviews applications within 1-3 days, but Discord allows for faster interaction and onboarding discussions. Welcome to the zk0 community! 🤖
